address: 2F, 28 Dalmaji-gil 62 beon-gil, Haeundae-gu, Busan, 48098, South Korea
bio: Yulling—named after the character signifying harmony and the suffix ‘-ing’ denoting continuity—is evolving under its new chef toward contemporary French cuisine. Simple yet precise cooking techniques are combined with diverse local ingredients of Busan to create dishes that feel both familiar and refreshingly new. Thoughtfully composed pairings further enhance the dining experience. Guests seated at the long counter can enjoy sweeping views of Dongbaekseom and Gwangan Bridge; reservations for sunset hours offer an especially memorable setting.
